package assistance_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/assistance"
)

type recorderStub struct {
	value domain.LearningActionAssistance
	event domain.IntegrationEvent
}

func (stub *recorderStub) Record(_ context.Context, value domain.LearningActionAssistance, event domain.IntegrationEvent) error {
	stub.value = value
	stub.event = event
	return nil
}

type idStub struct{ values []string }

func (stub *idStub) NewID() string {
	value := stub.values[0]
	stub.values = stub.values[1:]
	return value
}

type clockStub struct{ value time.Time }

func (stub clockStub) Now() time.Time { return stub.value }

func TestRecordCreatesVersionedAssistanceEvent(t *testing.T) {
	recorder := &recorderStub{}
	ids := &idStub{values: []string{
		"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
	}}
	hintLevel := 2
	useCase := assistance.Record{
		Assistance: recorder,
		IDs:        ids,
		Clock:      clockStub{value: time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 8, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)},
	}

	got, err := useCase.Execute(context.Background(), assistance.RecordInput{
		PersonalTeacherID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		StudentID:         "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		CorrelationID:     "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		CausationID:       "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777",
		LearningActionID:  "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		ContextType:       domain.LearningContextLessonTask,
		ContextID:         "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
		SupportContext:    domain.TeacherSupportGuided,
		HintsUsed:         1,
		MaxHintLevel:      &hintLevel,
		Observations: []domain.TeacherAssistanceObservation{
			{
				Target: domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetCapability, Key: "go.errors.wrap"},
				Kind:   domain.TeacherObservationHintUsed,
			},
		},
		PolicyVersion: "teacher-assistance-v1",
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", got.ID)
	require.Equal(t, domain.SubjectTeacherAssistanceObserved, recorder.event.Subject)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherAssistanceObservedSchemaVersion, recorder.event.SchemaVersion)

	var envelope domain.EventEnvelope
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(recorder.event.Payload, &envelope))
	require.Equal(t, got.StudentID, envelope.StudentID)
	require.NotContains(t, string(envelope.Data), "mastery")
	require.Contains(t, string(envelope.Data), `"observations"`)
}
